summary: This is a routine earnings press release filed by Ternium S.A. on Form 6-K announcing first quarter 2026 results. The filing contains standard financial metrics such as shipments, adjusted EBITDA, net income, and cash flow, along with an operational outlook. It references a previously completed acquisition of Usiminas shares but does not itself announce or initiate a special situation. No new strategic review, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other corporate event is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary periodic report and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
